summary: CR-2026-10-03-003 QA (Role 4) verification: feedback moved from our backend to CRM POST /scan/feedback. All 11 required checks (Q1-Q12 excl. Q11 known-note) PASS. Backend smoke 19/19 and contract 14/14 PASS. Frontend: no-token sign-in gate, token happy-path POSTs to CRM with Bearer + correct JSON body, hard-reload shows form (not sign-in), 500 interception shows error toast and keeps form, empty-submit validation blocks and sends no request, double-click submits only one POST (button shows 'Submitting...' and is disabled), config feedbackEnabled=false hides Feedback hamburger entry on landing, and /478 /478/menu /478/review-order have no console errors mentioning FeedbackPage or crmSubmitFeedback. No code changes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-2026-10-03-003 is fully verified at Role 4. The feedback-signin-required/feedback-signin-btn/feedback-success/feedback-form/feedback-message/feedback-star-{1..5}/feedback-submit-btn data-testids are stable and reliable. For future CRs touching FeedbackPage, use page.route('**/scan/feedback', ...) to intercept the CRM call cleanly (it is cross-origin; feedback POST goes to REACT_APP_CRM_URL host, not /api). Q5 can be flaky if CRM profile validation (setRestaurantScope -> crmGetProfile) is slow — wait up to 20-25s for 'feedback-form or feedback-signin-required'. The hamburger entries on the /478 landing are built from backend config; feedbackEnabled=false both at top-level and body.config.feedbackEnabled must be set when intercepting /api/config/{rid}.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration is QA sign-off, not a bug RCA. CR-2026-10-03-003 moved feedback writes out of our backend into CRM's canonical /scan/feedback contract, removing a schema-mismatch bug where our backend wrote into CRM's shared 'feedback' Mongo collection in the wrong shape. Verification confirms: (1) no server-side feedback routes remain; (2) frontend posts directly to CRM with Bearer token and correct JSON shape; (3) unauthenticated diners see a sign-in prompt and emit zero network traffic to scan/feedback or /orders; (4) UX safeguards (double-submit lock, validation, error toast) all work; (5) adjacent config route and other pages are unaffected.
